faculty.name: Dolores Albarracín
faculty.summary: Studies how communication and persuasion shape attitudes, beliefs, and behavior, and designs interventions that promote health, science understanding, and beneficial policy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究传播与说服如何塑造态度、信念与行为，并设计促进健康、科学理解和有益公共政策的干预措施。

faculty.name: Sarah Banet-Weiser
faculty.summary: Critically analyzes gender, race, and consumer culture in popular media, examining popular feminism and misogyny, brand culture, and the politics of believability.
faculty.summary_zh: 以批判视角分析流行媒介中的性别、种族与消费文化，考察流行女性主义与厌女、品牌文化以及“可信度”政治。

faculty.name: Damon Centola
faculty.summary: Studies how behaviors and innovations spread through social networks, using online network experiments and agent-based modeling to explain collective intelligence and behavior change.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为与创新如何在社会网络中扩散，运用在线网络实验和基于主体的建模解释集体智慧与行为改变。

faculty.name: Emily Falk
faculty.summary: Uses neuroscience and psychology to study what makes messages persuasive, how ideas spread, and how communication can drive health and climate behavior change.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用神经科学与心理学方法研究信息何以具有说服力、观念如何传播，以及传播如何推动健康与气候相关的行为改变。

faculty.name: Deen Freelon
faculty.summary: Studies digital politics and the politics of race, gender, and ideology on social media, using computational methods and building open-source research software.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究数字政治以及社交媒体中种族、性别与意识形态的政治，运用计算方法并开发开源研究软件。

faculty.name: Sandra González-Bailón
faculty.summary: Studies how online communication networks and algorithmic curation shape exposure to news and political information, using network analysis and computational social science.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究在线传播网络与算法推荐如何塑造人们对新闻和政治信息的接触，采用网络分析与计算社会科学方法。

faculty.name: Amy Gutmann
faculty.summary: Develops political theory on democracy, deliberation, and compromise, with work on democratic education, bioethics, identity politics, and ethics in public affairs.
faculty.summary_zh: 从政治理论角度研究民主、协商与妥协，涉及民主教育、生命伦理、身份政治与公共事务伦理。

faculty.name: John L. Jackson, Jr.
faculty.summary: Combines ethnography and filmmaking to study race, visual culture, Black religious media, and diasporic religious communities.
faculty.summary_zh: 结合民族志与影像创作，研究种族、视觉文化、黑人宗教媒体以及离散宗教社群。

faculty.name: Sarah J. Jackson
faculty.summary: Studies how Black, feminist, and activist publics use and are represented in media, journalism, and digital networks, from hashtag activism to histories of Black mediamakers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究黑人、女性主义与社会运动群体如何使用媒介、新闻与数字网络并在其中被再现，涵盖标签行动主义与黑人媒体创作者的历史。

faculty.name: Kathleen Hall Jamieson
faculty.summary: Uses rhetorical analysis, surveys, and experiments to study campaign communication, the science of science communication, and ways to counter misinformation and conspiracy theories.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用修辞分析、调查与实验研究竞选传播、科学传播的科学，以及应对虚假信息与阴谋论的方法。

faculty.name: John B. Jemmott III
faculty.summary: Develops and tests theory-based health behavior change interventions that reduce sexual risk behavior and health disparities among underserved populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发并检验基于理论的健康行为改变干预，以减少弱势人群的性风险行为和健康差距。

faculty.name: Yphtach Lelkes
faculty.summary: Studies affective polarization, political belief systems, and how changes in the information environment shape political attitudes, using surveys, experiments, and quasi-experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情感极化、政治信念体系以及信息环境变化如何影响政治态度，运用调查、实验与准实验方法。

faculty.name: Matthew Levendusky
faculty.summary: Studies public opinion and the causes and consequences of political polarization in the U.S., including partisan media effects and ways to bridge the partisan divide.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国的公众舆论以及政治极化的成因与后果，包括党派媒体的影响和弥合党派分歧的途径。

faculty.name: Jessa Lingel
faculty.summary: Uses qualitative and interpretive methods to study digital culture, how marginalized groups appropriate technology, the politics of infrastructure, and technological activism.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性与阐释方法研究数字文化、边缘群体如何挪用技术、基础设施的政治以及技术行动主义。

faculty.name: Juan Llamas-Rodriguez
faculty.summary: Critically analyzes borders, migration, and Latin American and Latinx digital and screen media, drawing on media theory, infrastructure studies, and film and television analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用媒介理论、基础设施研究与影视分析，批判性地考察边境、移民以及拉丁美洲和拉美裔的数字与影视媒介。

faculty.name: David Lydon-Staley
faculty.summary: Studies daily fluctuations in brain, behavior, and media environments to understand curiosity, emotion dynamics, and substance use, using fMRI, experience sampling, and network analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑、行为与媒介环境的日常波动，以理解好奇心、情绪动态和物质使用，采用功能磁共振、经验取样与网络分析方法。

faculty.name: Diana C. Mutz
faculty.summary: Studies political communication, political psychology, and how the American mass public forms opinions on issues, candidates, and globalization.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究政治传播、政治心理学，以及美国大众如何就议题、候选人和全球化形成观点。

faculty.name: Desmond Upton Patton
faculty.summary: Studies how social media relates to violence, trauma, grief, and mental health among youth of color, combining data science, qualitative methods, and community partnerships.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社交媒体与有色人种青少年的暴力、创伤、哀伤和心理健康之间的关系，结合数据科学、质性方法与社区合作。

faculty.name: Victor Pickard
faculty.summary: Studies media policy, political economy, media history, and journalism's democratic role, using historical and policy analysis of media reform and internet governance.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒介政策、政治经济学、媒介史以及新闻业的民主角色，以历史与政策分析考察媒介改革与互联网治理。

faculty.name: Aswin Punathambekar
faculty.summary: Takes cultural and historical approaches to media industries, audiences, and identity politics in South Asia and the South Asian diaspora in the U.S. and U.K.
faculty.summary_zh: 以文化与历史路径研究南亚及其在英美的离散社群中的媒介产业、受众与身份政治。

faculty.name: Andy Tan
faculty.summary: Studies marketing, media, and message effects on tobacco and cancer disparities, designing culturally tailored interventions with LGBT and underserved communities through mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究营销、媒体与信息效果对烟草和癌症健康差距的影响，通过混合方法与LGBT及弱势社群共同设计文化适配的干预。

faculty.name: Julia Ticona
faculty.summary: Uses qualitative methods to examine how phones, platforms, and management systems shape precarious low-wage work and inequalities of gender, race, and class.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用质性方法考察手机、平台与管理系统如何塑造不稳定的低薪劳动以及性别、种族和阶级不平等。

faculty.name: Duncan J. Watts
faculty.summary: Uses web-based experiments and large-scale digital data to study social and organizational networks, collective dynamics, and the production and consumption of news.
faculty.summary_zh: 运用网络实验与大规模数字数据研究社会与组织网络、集体动态以及新闻的生产与消费。

faculty.name: Guobin Yang
faculty.summary: Takes historical and cultural approaches to social movements, digital activism, and the politics of emotion and storytelling, with a focus on contemporary China.
faculty.summary_zh: 以历史与文化路径研究社会运动、数字行动主义以及情感与叙事的政治，聚焦当代中国。
